text:
sara: Quick heads up — product wants a new console dashboard showing per-route latency, p50/p95/p99, token cost, and quota usage. Need runtime and infra signals. Thinking: runtime emits detailed request events, infra emits GPU/queue metrics. Thoughts?

michael: +1. Do we want raw request events in Prom? Pull model is messy for request-level events. Might be better to push to Kafka and do aggregation downstream.

ajay: Agreed on Kafka. We can have a small exporter on runtime nodes that batches request events -> kafka topic `redwood_metrics.requests`. Then Flink job for aggregations.

sara: Sounds good. Product asked for 90d retention on the dashboard but fast rollups for 1y. Propose raw (30d), aggregates (90d), long-term rollups (365d).

elaine: What about quotas/usage? We need token accounting per API key and route. Token counts come from runtime but we need join keys: request_id, api_key, model_version, route. Make sure exporter includes those fields.

michael: exporter schema sketch: `{request_id, ts, api_key_hash, model, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, node_id}`. No PII. api_key hashed at emitter.

sara: Good. Product also wants per-route cost breakdown by model/quantization. We'll need model cost table upstream and join during aggregation.

ajay: For aggregation ops: propose hourly aggregations for dashboard (p50/p95/p99, sum tokens, requests) and 1-min for recent 1h heatmap. Use Flink windowing: 1min tumbling for recent, 1h tumbling for dashboard.

elaine: Storage plan — raw events -> Kafka -> S3 for raw + ClickHouse for aggregates? ClickHouse can handle the p95/p99 queries cheaply. Alternatives?

michael: ClickHouse works. We already have infra for ClickHouse in analytics cluster. Put hourly aggregates into `analytics.metrics_hourly`, materialized views for fast P95-ish approximations (quantileTDigest).

sara: Backfill: product wants last 30d visible on day 1. Can we backfill from request logs? We have request logs in s3/requests/*.gz for last 60d.

ajay: Yes, we can run a backfill job that reads logs, publishes to the same kafka topic or directly writes aggregates to ClickHouse. Risk: duplicates if we also replay Kafka. Need an idempotency plan (use request_id).

elaine: Retention policy: raw events TTL 30d, hourly aggregates 365d, daily rollups 5y? But ClickHouse disk cost increases. Maybe make 365d for hourly and 5y for monthly rollups only.

michael: Agree. Also include downsampling: after 90d, only keep hourly -> weekly aggregates.

sara: UX/rollouts: dashboards must support rollout comparisons (canary vs stable). Need to propagate `deployment_tag` from runtime for each request so we can filter.

ajay: We'll add `deployment_tag` optional field. If missing, treat as `unknown`.

elaine: Ops questions: CPU/GPU telemetry — we need node-level metrics (GPU util, queue length) correlated with request spikes. Those already in Prometheus; just need to join on 1m windows.

michael: Right. Plan: use Flink to join request aggregates with Prom metrics pulled into Kafka via metricbeat -> kafka. Keep join keys as minute timestamp + node_id.

sara: Action items: 1) ajay to add emitter to runtime (schema above) 2) michael to provision ClickHouse table + materialized views 3) elaine to prepare backfill job for 30d and sanity checks 4) sara to update product with retention/rollup plan. Anyone object?

ajay: On it. ETA for emitter: 1 week. I'll open a PR with config and a Docker image.

michael: I'll create CH schema and an initial materialized view Monday.

elaine: Backfill: I'll prototype a Spark job this week and test on a subset. Will post results.

sara: Great. Can we sync Tuesday 10am to lock down quotas mapping and dashboard widgets? @michael @ajay @elaine :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment started for `runtime-emitter:v2` on infra-prod (3 nodes)

ajay: Nice, that's the new emitter image — I pushed it to the dev cluster for smoke.

sara: Thanks everyone. I'll drop a short RFC doc in `#eng-platform` with the schema, retention table, and backfill plan.
